proof_hypotheses_and_limits: The finite optimization proof covers exactly the stated menu: unhedged noon capital (64-141x)/9 is negative for x>=1/2; credit protection reduces early resources. Half escrow needs x<=46/73; full escrow yields (64-5x)/9. The four candidates and strict score margin complete this finite argument without claiming a continuous optimum.

The matrix oracle uses cumulative signed resources at 09:00, 12:00 and 16:00, then positive and negative parts to recover cash and nominal arrears. Under the documented input bounds every policy first redeems at least 20, so there is no hidden earlier unpaid priority in that simplification.

Tail ES is a fixed-mass maximization over three atoms; its vertices have at most one non-bound mass. This independent computation differs from the model sorted-tail algorithm and author threshold-minimization oracle. The manuscript itself supplies the directly understandable atom calculation.

Both reverse boundaries fix the same half-note/quarter-escrow positions and vary total loss from baseline. Before-trade funding changes the slope; compound delay or priority changes remove the one-variable certificate. Admissible decimal neighbors test strict versus inclusive decisions without pretending 19/9 or 19/7 is a finite JSON decimal.

The incomplete-price proof assumes all four states possible, strictly positive consistent state prices and unrestricted reference comparison positions. The explicit hedge witnesses exclude endpoints; Cedar mandate restrictions remain separate.
Exact algebra, deterministic computation and simulated hypothetical cash rights do not establish empirical frequencies, actual title, execution, legal powers or institution-wide welfare.
rights_and_resources: Client payer, sponsor, underwriter, new subscriber, bill issuer and both protection pools have distinct endowments. Every entry payer prefix remains nonnegative; the listed entry accounts conserve 272.

The premium purchases an existing dealer fraction; it never contributes cash to either writer pool. Dealer holdings plus Cedar holdings remain one unit of each claim. Idle pool resources return to their actual owner only at the stated release time.

SPV project costs and equipment sale are not double-counted. The parent contributes an economically valuable pre-existing opportunity, not another cash subscription. Parent cash and SPV property remain separated.

Actual partial payments reduce claims; impairment and zero further modeled recovery do not legally cancel unpaid project, protection or client face. A capital floor is only a policy test and is not a creditor priority.

Post-trade actual holdings stay fixed even when a different historical-entry policy ranks first. Shown counterfactual ledgers are labeled, prospective approval is null, and institution_approval tests actual holdings plus the separate parent gate.
External customer, equipment-buyer and bill receipts are explicitly funded assumptions. Conservation is limited to the listed accounts and each waterfall, not an unmodeled whole economy.
